generator: reference tools of the Holiday Lights 5.4 analysis (not part of this repository; see Golden/README.md)
reference: cells cut from the 5.4 RT_BITMAP art and mask resources (identical bytes to assets/builtin/bmp) with the rectangles of the 5.4 table (assets/builtin/table.json)

conventions.rgba: SHA-256 over width*height*4 bytes, rows top to bottom, pixels left to right, bytes R,G,B,A; A = 255 where the 1-bpp mask pixel is black (bit set) and 0 elsewhere; RGB = art colour where A = 255, 0,0,0 where A = 0 (the OR fringe is NOT baked in)
conventions.rect: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in art-bitmap pixels, top-left origin, x1/y1 exclusive (CellIndexToRect, normal rows 0..3)
conventions.sides: sides[side][flavor][phase] = cell number for side 0..3 = top, right, bottom, left, flavor < flavorCount, phase < phaseCount (= edgeCells[side][flavor][phase])
conventions.corners: corners[corner][phase] = cell number, corner 0..3 = topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft (slots 4..7)
conventions.cells: every referenced cell (keyed by its 1-based number): rect, opaque pixel count, sha256
